context: Saito advises Yuki on managing an illness alone.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical advice; vocabulary (電気/病気/ひとり/普段/両親) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: この病気は、重いんでしょうか?
lines.style: worried office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 普段の生活で、十分管理できますよ。
lines.en: It can be managed well in daily life.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ひとり暮らしでも、大丈夫ですか?
lines.en: Is it okay even living alone?
lines.style: concerned office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ひとりでも、普段から気をつければ平気です。
lines.en: Even alone, you're fine if you're careful daily.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm reassuring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 両親にも、伝えた方がいいですか?
lines.en: Should I tell my parents too?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ご両親に話せば、心強いですよ。
lines.en: Telling your parents would be reassuring.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 夜は、電気を消して早く休みます。
lines.en: At night I'll turn off the light and rest early.
lines.style: resolved office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 普段の休息が、病気を遠ざけますよ。
lines.en: Daily rest keeps illness at bay.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
